title: Single-degree comparison for constructible sheaves
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, an algebraic closure $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ and a finite subextension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$. Let $X$ be a locally Noetherian, quasi-compact scheme ([pqf-def-locnoeth], [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme]). Let $\Lambda=\underline E$ or $\underline{\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell}$ be the condensed ring of [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring] or [sk-def-sfb-qlbar-condensed], and let $\mathcal A=\Mod_{\Lambda_X}$ be the module category of [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients], [sk-def-sfb-module-objects]. Choose a derived-category localization $D(\mathcal A)$ in the fixed Hom universe [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let $C$ be a constructible sheaf [sk-def-sfb-constructible]. Let $a,s\in\mathbf Z$ and let $(K_i)_{i\in I}$ be a small family in $D(\mathcal A)$ concentrated in degree $a$ for the standard t-structure [def-sbc-standard-tstructure-derived-category]. Suppose each $H^a(K_i)$ is a small filtered colimit of constructible sheaves in $\mathcal A$. For any colimit cofan $c$ of this family, the natural map
$$\bigoplus_{i\in I}\operatorname{Hom}_{D(\mathcal A)}(C[0],K_i[s])\longrightarrow\operatorname{Hom}_{D(\mathcal A)}(C[0],c[s]),\qquad(f_i)\longmapsto\sum_i\iota_i[s]\circ f_i$$
is bijective. This includes negative shifts, zero objects and the empty family.

source.place: Proof, base case a=b and displayed Ext comparison

proof.text: The standard t-structure gives vanishing H^q(K_i)=0 for q != a. Apply DerivedCategory.nonempty_iso_singleFunctor_obj_homologyFunctor_obj to identify K_i with its degree-a homology placed in degree a. This source-library concentration theorem is proved for every abelian category and arbitrary localization presentation.

source.place: Proof, base case identification K_i = H^a(K_i)[-a]

proof.text: Form the coproduct cofan cB of B_i=H^a(K_i) in the Grothendieck category of module objects. The single-complex functor preserves coproducts degreewise. Apply isColimit_mapCocone_grothendieckSum to see that localization of that termwise sum cofan is a derived coproduct. The chosen cofan c is uniquely isomorphic to this single-complex cofan through the component concentration isomorphisms.

source.place: Proof, termwise coproduct and degree-a single complexes

proof.text: The single-functor shift isomorphisms identify Hom(C[0],B_i[-a][s]) with Ext^(s-a)(C,B_i), naturally also on the coproduct. The existing Ext-sum theorem uses the canonical Grothendieck derived presentation; transport it to the chosen presentation by the uniqueness equivalence of localizations. This equivalence is additive and commutes with shifts. Its full faithfulness, shift isomorphism and localization-factorization isomorphism give a natural additive Hom isomorphism; naturality identifies the coproduct comparison maps on each summand. Apply det_ind_heart_ii_sums and transport bijectivity along these isomorphisms.

proof_origin.place: Base case a=b, with explicit single-complex coproduct and localization-presentation transport

lean.statement:
theorem constructible_single_degree_comparison
    (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] (E : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField ℓ)
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsLocallyNoetherian X] [CompactSpace X]
    (Λ : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1})
    [MonObj Λ] [IsCommMonObj Λ]
    (hΛ : Λ = Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E ∨ Λ = Profinite.padicAlgClRingObj ℓ)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{u + 1}
      (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ X))]
    (C : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ X))
    (hC : IsConstantModelConstructible Λ X C)
    (a : ℤ) (I : Type (u + 1))
    (K : I → DerivedCategory
      (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ X)))
    (c : Cofan K) (hc : IsColimit c)
    (hge : ∀ i, (K i).IsGE a) (hle : ∀ i, (K i).IsLE a)
    (hK : ∀ i, ObjectProperty.ind.{u + 1} (IsConstantModelConstructible Λ X)
      ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ a).obj (K i))) (s : ℤ) :
    Function.Bijective
      (DirectSum.toAddMonoid (fun i ↦
        Preadditive.rightComp ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj C)
          ((shiftFunctor _ s).map (c.inj i))))
